**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nadia8666/pa-tools/commits/TAG

- Hole Cutter now tracks groups with CollectionService tags and cached part lists instead of repeatedly scanning all workspace descendants. Per-part change tracking and debounced validation keep group state current.
- Axis-aligned block targets and cutters now use a manual geometry-splitting path, with oriented-box intersection checks to reject cutters that do not intersect. Other geometry uses GeometryService subtraction without an unnecessary cutter-union step.
- Applying cuts now preserves child instances, attachments, joints, constraints, ObjectValue references, and model PrimaryParts across generated pieces. Failed commits restore the original parts and relationships.
- Hole Cutter now refreshes group tracking across edits, merges, undo, and redo; highlights active target groups; and migrates existing groups that use the legacy attributes.

**TOOLS:**
_`paTools.lua` is a required plugin. Download other plugins as needed:_

| Name | Description |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| `PASync.lua` | Sync code and attribute changes bidirectionally with full Team Create support and per-place configs |
| `combinePlugin.lua` | Combine arbitrary parts, meshes, and unions into optimized bulk meshes with precise collision |
| `districtMapper.lua` | Edit the district nodemap and edit height boundaries |
| `holeCutter.lua` | Cut holes into groups of parts and merge axis-aligned part groups together |
| `edgeFill.lua` | Preview and apply fence segments or texture-aligned trim around surface edges |
| `worldSelector.lua` | Bulk select instances within 3D bounds and compare spatial diffs |
